batting.dismissal: c CH Morris b R Ashwin

batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b SK Raina

batting.name: DJG Sammy

batting.dismissal: c JO Holder b CH Morris

balls.text: full-toss and whiles spanked it over the extra-cover fielder for a four, he misses his century by a single, still an excellent innings and a trademark shot to end it too!

that' very full and driven through to extra-cover for a single, no wait, they are coming back for the second and there's a run-out appeal now, and to add to it, he's also bowled a no-ball! Raina's in and that means he moves to 95, he's got a Free-Hit and more vitally an extra ball to get to a century, replays show it was a marginal call
goes down the track and cuts it through to deep point for a single to get Raina back on strike
very full and on the off stump, that's drilled down the ground, easily beats the long-off fielder for a four
fuller on the off stump and drives it straight to extra-cover which gets him a single
up and over yet again but this is hit squarer this time and it was going away to the fence yet again, Vihari gets his hand out to the right and stops it, gets a couple
shorter in length, wide outside the off stump and that's called wide too, poor delivery
it starts as was expected, shorter in length, very slow too and easily pulled away to the leg side for a four
fuller, width and gets an outside edge through to third-man for a single which means that Raina gets the strike
slows down the pace and shortens it, he was looking to play that favourite shot over extra-cover, beats the shot with the change of pace and it rolls back to the bowler
too much width yet again but Jadeja only cuts it through to third-man for a single
wow, even Steyn's been taken for runs this over, this is shorter in length and that's cut away through that same backward point area for another boundary
slows the pace down and now Jadeja joins in the fun, it was shorter in length and cut away through backward point and to the fence
outside the off stump, really quick and he was giving himself room, trying to cut, does not get close to the edge of the bat, through to the keeper

whatever's happened to Perera, he continues to bowl those full-tosses and while off a couple he's got wickets, the others have been dispatched away by Raina, looks like he's waltzing towards another century here
another full-toss, and this time Raina is able to find the gap on the leg side, flicked away through to the deep square-leg fence for a four

and now he's gone is Dhoni, another full-toss and he seems to have hit it well, but Karan Sharma is on the boundary at deep mid-wicket and he judges it rather well while on the run back, takes the catch and the captain's walking back
another full-toss and he wants to flick it over the leg side, gets an outside edge for a couple

full-toss and that's dropped! Sitter! Dale Steyn! he was looking to pull it away and gets the top-edge of the bat, goes high to the left of the fielder and he drops it, called a no-ball for the height, so wouldn't have mattered

bowled him, that's the line, that's the length and that's the wicket! it was very full but slight swing back into the batsman, he was looking to play it over the leg side but fails to get under it, it sneaks through to hit the leg-stump, which lies flat now
full-toss on his pads and he's lucky the batsman can only get it to short fine-leg, straight to the fielder
finally gets one right, it's fuller outside the off and they get only a single to long-off
this is a bouncer attempted, for a change I may add, but I should also say that the result does not change, the ball does not rise too much and it's easily pulled away over the in-field for a four
wow, he's continuing to play those strokes like he's got nothing to lose, on a length and he stands tall, and hits it on the up and over the extra-cover region, inside-out again!
this is amazing batting, added to some poor bowling, it was a full-toss this time, on the off stump and easily patted over the extra-cover region for a four, good shot-making off some poor bowling

see that's what he was afraid of Ishant, finally gets it close to the middle-stump, in fact it's on the middle and it's on a length and Raina does a Miller, in his arc and it's outside the park, six more
whoa, that is Stephen Hamisonesque in his wide, he was moving towards the off stump alright but Ishant has sent it down so wide that the batsman on the adjacent pitch could have got a nick on it
up and over, yep, he's not found his line and length for sure, it was on a very full length but more vitally it was very wide too, gave him enough room to free his arm and that's tonked
wide, wide, wide outside the off stump and called so, he's not found his line or length tonight Ishant
and he celebrates that now with an inside-out shot that goes all the way for a six! it was a googly that was shorter in length, he only taps it over, times it and that's gone all the way!
and now he goes down the track and takes it on the full, hits it over the bowler to get the two runs that will mean that OC will sit on his head tonight
on the off stump, slightly shorter in length, tapped to the off side for a single
shorter in length and tucks it to the leg side for a single, hey but wait, he's tapped it so slowly that they are able to come back for the second by the time the fielder gets in, 50 for Raina
clean as they come, very full from the leggie and not too much turn, he jabs it down through wide long-off for a four
and now he goes down the track and wants to crack it away, gets it off the middle of the bat too but straight to extra-cover

and this is an excellent shot, that was on his pads again, or would have been on his pads had he not shuffled across to the leg stump and got it off the middle of the bat, through to the deep point region for a four
down the leg side and he wants to flick it again, misses it this time and the umpire does not give it a wide, was too close to the leg stump I feel

that's on his pads, it was a quickish delivery too and he fails to get any bat on it, hits his pads and there's an appeal from the bowler but the ump just walks away, it rushes to the fence where it's stopped and they get a couple of leg-byes
on his pads yet again and easily flicked away to fine-leg for a single
that was a quickish ball on his pads and he wants to whip it through the leg side, what he gets is an inside-edge and that runs away to fine-leg for a four
fullish and quicker from the bowler, and tapped down the ground, hits Hussey on its way through to the long-off fielder
was looking to go down the track but stopped in his tracks, and pushes it to the leg side for a single
fuller from the bowler, a quicker one too and he pulls out a jab through to the deep square-leg area for a couple of runs

goes down the track and he bowls it shorter, almost beats the batsman, who gets an outside edge, runs across to the short third-man, good ball otherwise, except that's a no-ball, which means it's a Free-Hit for Raina!
fuller from Mishra, a very straight-looking bat gets him a very straight drive to long-off for a single
shorter in length and very slow too, he goes back and this time ensures he's got the gap, for a single
short outside the off and he misses finding the gap on that cut, straight to the fielder
goes down the track to hoick him over the in-field, gets the outside edge of the bat, it was a googly, and almost gets to the short third-man fielder
shortish on length and he's quickly on to the back foot, tucks it to the leg side for a single
short of length and on the middle stump, he's able to open the face of the bat and run it down to third-man for a single
whoa, short of length and he was looking swivel around and guide it to fine-leg, gets a bottom edge, hits his body and was almost rolling on to the stumps
easily driven through to third-man for a single to get to his 50! Well-played innings and that's taken only 32 deliveries to get to as well
on his pads, and it's quick too, does not get any bat on it, rolls to the leg side where the bowler runs across quickly and prevents a single
shorter in length and he opens the the face of the bat for a single to third-man
fuller from round the stumps and driven to long-on for a single
round the stumps cutting in between the umpire and the stumps and full, driven in the air and through the covers for a single
shortens his length slightly and he's back, tapping it down to long-on for a single
fullish ball on the middle and he chips it over the bowler's head, gets an easy couple of runs as the long-on fielder comes across to get there
fuller on the leg stump and drives it to long-on for a single
dropped by Karan! that should have been taken at point! shorter in length and he cuts it, does not place it too well and it goes straight to the fielder, who floors it
a slower one and a shorter one too, Hussey bends his front foot and pulls it over fine-leg for a six, one of the worst deliveries you can bowl with the fine-leg inside the circle
slower again, he's releasing them from the back of his fingers and he's able to cut it away for a single
shortish in length and that's cut away through third-man for a four, that's easy pickings again, too much width
another one that's slower, he tries to cut it away and misfielded by the in-fielder, they are able to go over for a single
slower one from Sammy and it's punched from the back foot, down to long-on for a single
short of length from round the stumps, he was looking to cut it first but lets it go in the end, thinks it will be called a wide, but isn't
poor delivery from Ishant who's taken a bit of a pounding here, it was short of length and a slower one, he easily helps it over the fine-leg area for a six, another six if I may add
fuller again but this is very wide outside the off, easy pickings for the batsman, who drives it through the covers for a couple of runs
slower bouncer from the bowler, he was looking to pull it but has to roll his bat over that one and it goes away for a single
and this is fuller from the bowler, it's on the off stump and he wants to drive it away, gets an inside edge that rolls over to the off side
shortish in length and he stands up tall, taps it to the leg side and rushes away for a single, there was a throw from Perera but Raina was diving in, it does not hit or could have gotten close
short of length from Ishant, who's back into the attack and Hussey's pulled it away, does not time it too well and it's bounced towards the deep square-leg for a single
goes down the track and it's been spanked for a six! a flat six that goes straight over the bowler's head, it was raining before the game and now it's raining during the game, sixes.
very, very short from the bowler, he's pulled away to the leg side, straight to the fielder for a single
on a length on the off stump, he wants to drive it away, gets a bottom edge back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump, and driven to the left of the bowler, fielded well
fuller on the middle stump, and pushes it to the off side
did I say that will make the batsman think? Probably it did, he's smacked it over long-on for a six, it was not hit too hard, just timed it and it's gone the distance
down the leg side and a wide, but that turned a lot and will make the batsman think
shorter in length and he's quickly on to his back foot and cuts but straight to the fielder
shorter in length and it's pushed back to the bowler
fuller on the middle stump and it's on the middle-stump, he drives it through wide long-on for a four
fuller on the middle and that's pushed down to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump and Hussey, who has been taking all those singles loves those, drills it through the covers for a four, easily beats the long-off fielder
on a length and he goes back, flicks it away to the leg side for a single
pitches it shorter and that's tapped to mid-wicket for a single
ooh, lot of turn back into Raina, who was walking to the off stump, is only able to tuck it to the in-fielder
tries to float it a tad more, he's on to his back foot and taps it to the off side for a single
very short in length and he pulls it through to deep mid-wicket, again for a single
shorter in length and that's tapped to deep square-leg for a single
on his pads and easily tucked away to the deep square-leg for a single
from round the stumps, it's shorter in length, tucked to the leg side for a single
on his pads, shorter in length too, tucked away to the leg side for a single
gives himself room and wants to go inside out, gets it over the in-field too and the captain gives a good chase through to deep cover, they come back for the third
over the wicket and outside the off stump, short of length and pushed into the covers

edged and gone! this is exactly the delivery that Ishant attempted last ball of the previous over, it was dug in short and it was bowled at a rapid pace, Vijay was stuck on his back foot, got some bat on it as he looked to fend at it, easily taken by the keeper
short of length outside the off stump from round the stumps and he's able to easily open his bat and push it down to third-man for a single
makes room and wants to hit it over the off side, it's short of length and gets extra bounce, beats the outside edge of the bat for a change
whoa, whoa, whoa, that's three sixes in three balls and Vijay, the out of form Vijay, has taken Ishant to the cleaners here, fuller and it's tonked over deep square-leg for a six!
and another six! what a shot, that favourite one of his, clear front leg and hoicking it over the leg-side, two in two for Vijay!

gone for a six! it did not look to have come off the middle of the bat, was short in length and he went for the hook, Dhawan was there at the backward square-leg fence and he jumps tall, but just eludes him
it's a length ball yet again and he wants to hoick it over mid-on, does not get too much bat on it and it goes on the bounce to Mishra at mid-on
on a good length and on the off stump, defended off the front foot to short mid-wicket
short of length and he's been pulled away for a four, poor ball yet again, he bowled one last ball which Vijay failed to connect but Hussey does not miss out

bouncer attempted and he wants to pull it away, gets only an inside edge that runs down to Steyn at short fine-leg, Hussey was running quickly and Steyn throws, but he's home, did not hit the stumps either
room given to the batsman and bit of swing away too, wants to cut it but gets an inside edge that goes on the bounce to the keeper
the length remains short but it's on the middle stump line, so he isn't able to either push it through the off or nudge it away, defends back
and that's been caressed through the covers for a four, it was on a length and easily tapped through that area
loose start from Perera, it was on his pads, not too much pace on it either and it's flicked away to the backward square-leg region for an easy boundary
on a length and on the middle stump line, flicked away to the leg side for a single
length ball and he goes back, pushes it to the off side, screams out "no!" and Hussey is back
bouncer and he's got to go down quickly, that wasn't only short, it was pacy, 145.2 km/hr, but it was also well-directed and Vijay did well
shorter in length but quick and outside the off, Vijay has time to punch it through the covers, finds the fielder at point
shortish in length, cramping him for room too and he was looking to nudge it away, hits the pads
the swing back into the batsman continues from Steyn but Hussey is able to open the face of the bat and push it through to third-man for a single
gets closer to the stumps, but it's short of length and he opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single

up and over and into the fence, this was a good length ball but it was wide outside the off too, enough room to swing his arm, the slowness of the track means that he's hit it over the extra-cover region rather than cut it hard
and finally a run for Hussey, and four of them actually, it is on a length and he goes for a shot on the up, beats the mid-off fielder...was in the air that one
wide outside the off stump, it was bowled from round the stumps, and he went for a flashy drive, it seemed to be within the line
and this is short of length, Vijay wants to go for that swipe he has across the line, gets an inside edge and it rolls over to the leg side for a single, the first run of the day
short of length now and a tad quicker, 137 km/hr, pushed back to the bowler
on his pads, not too quick too and he rolls his wrists over that one, was in the air but falls well short of the fielder at short mid-wicket
and that's a maiden to begin with, it's very similar to the previous ball and he's on to the back, defending to the off side
good length delivery and he's on the back foot, defending to the off side, to the fielder to bring up the fifth dot of the over, lot of respect from the batsman
on the middle stump and slight movement back into Hussey, who taps it back to the bowler, again for a dot
not as full as the previous one, he was looking to drive at it but it gets an inside edge and it runs over to mid-on
and this is a lot closer to the stumps, on the middle and swinging back too, Hussey is careful and pushes it into the covers
outside the off stump, not too much swing back into the batsman, on a good length and he's shouldered arms, lets it go through to the keeper
fuller on the middle stump and it's drilled through to the backward point area for a couple of runs
bouncer and that's gone way, way above the batsman, it was a quick one too but given a wide now
shorter this time and quicker too, looking to pull it away but gets only a top-edge which goes to Holder, who takes a good catch
and he's spanked him over the long-on region for a six, was a slower one and right in the arc, sends it out of the park...couldn't resist that one!
keeping it up to the bat, wants to flick it away, through to the leg side for a single
fuller on the middle stump, and it's drilled straight to the fielder at mid-on, Holder has a shy at the stumps and the batsman is miles out, misses
fuller from round the stumps, drilled to third-man for a single
finally manages to get it away, was shorter in length and he opens the face of the bat and gets it over the point region for a four
swings and misses, it was a slower one and he does not read that change-down of pace
short of length and he wants to cut it away, opens the stance up too but does not get too much of timing
on the leg-stump line and he opens the face of the bat through to point for a single
fuller from round the stumps, driven down to long-on for a single
outside the off stump and chops the ball, on the bounce to the point fielder
fuller, he goes out on the front foot, taps it to the off side and they are away for a quick single
wow, what a shot, it was a very quick delivery, opens the face of the bat and gets it away very, very fine, probably bit of an edge too
enough of those attempted cut shots now, it was a slower one and he swivels around and hits it over mid-wicket for a six
wide outside the off and he should have put that away, hits it straight to the point fielder
quicker and flatter, but outside the off stump, punched down the ground for a single
fuller outside the off stump, was looking to cut it, beaten
it is on a length and he was looking to drive it through the covers, gets the bottom of the bat and it rushes to the left of the third-man fielder, a dive from Holder stops it
short of length and wants to cut it away, beats the outside edge of the bat
whoosh, quicker this time and it's beaten the outside edge of the bat
fuller in length this time but far slower and he wants to go over the in-field, does not time it too well, gets it out to the deep square-leg for a single
bouncer from round the stumps and Steyn's gone under it, lets it go through to the keeper
slower on the off stump and he opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single
shorter in length and the ball turns away from the bat, he's on the back foot, defending it back to the bowler
shorter in length and that's tapped back to the bowler
slows it down and shortens the length, cuts it to the point region, a single this time
outside the off stump and turn back into the batsman, pushed to the point fielder
fuller and that's hit back to the bowler, seems like he's flicked the ball back on to the stumps, there's a big appeal for a run-out and replays suggest that Mishra is quite out of his crease
shorter in length and that's punched through the extra-cover for a single
on his pads, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
shorter and wants to cut, goes straight to the deep point fielder for a single

and now Vijay's dropped it! he was looking a tad casual there, hit to the long-on fielder, catches it but realises it late that the boundary is just behind him, he has to let go off the ball and tumble over the fence, the catch is dropped but does not get the batsman a six
slower one, on a good length and his bat is very far from the ball, beaten
wants to pull it away, but it's not too short and it's a mere waft at it, beaten
round the stumps and fuller on the off stump, driven down to long-on for a single
on his pads and flicks it to the leg side for a single
that's another one that's very short, he goes to cut it, gets it over the point fielder and comes back for the second
was looking to give himself room, wants to drive it but the length ball has tapped it to the off side
short of length and it's defended on the back foot, back to the bowler
short in length and he was looking to upper cut it, beats the outside edge
dropped by Hussey! it was a bouncer and he was looking to pull it, Hussey was there and looked like it was covered, straight to him, in and then pops out!
short of length and tapped to the leg side for a single

and now that's gone, caught on the second attempt! it was a slower one and the batsman was trying to slog it again, it gets the edge and goes high and towards third-man, was third-man's catch for sure but Badri runs back from the point region needs two attempts to grab it, does well in the end
shot, short arm jab and it's gone all the way! wow, what a shot, it was on his pads and full but the batsman was looking to move away and tap it over, does that successfully
slower one from Bravo, he was looking to slog it over but does not time it, gets it to wide long-on for a single
shorter from the bowler from round the stumps, and he was looking to leave the ball and hope for the wide, does not bounce too much
fuller on the leg stump and drives it down to long-on for a single
slows it down considerably and the batsman waits for the turn, tucks it to the leg side for a single
fuller and drives it back to the bowler
fuller and on the off stump, turning back yet again, pushed to the off side for a single
whoa, that turns back into the left hander, almost like a leggie, it wasn't picked by the batsman and hits his pads, appeal but not given
fuller on the pads and flicked it away to the leg side for a single
fuller on the middle stump and driven through to wide long-off for a single
shorter in length and slower one too, he was trying to flick it towards the leg side, but straight to the fielder
and now he's tonked it over the long-on fence for a six! it was a short of length delivery yet again and he gets his front foot out and smashes it over the field for a biggie
clears his front foot and slogs it through wide mid-on for a four, was a short of length ball and easily hit
shorter in length and he opens the face of the bat down to third-man for a single
short of length and he wants to pull it way, beats the top edge of the bat, misses
leading edge and it goes high in the air but over the bowler's head, he was looking to flick it away but the lack of pace defeats him
shorter in length and pushed down the ground for a single
quicker and a carrom ball that comes back into the batsman from round the stumps, pushed forward for a single
inside out and that's been tapped over the extra-cover region for a four
on his pads and he was looking to defend it, back to the bowler
outside edge and it runs through the short third-man region for a four
shorter in length and that's pushed to the leg side for a single

cracked and gone! short of length and he times it so well that it seems to have gone all the way, except that there's Vijay at deep square-leg who takes it as casually as Bravo dances, half the side gone now
very full from the bowler this time, he was looking to go down the track but isn't able to get under it, inside edge through to the keeper
short of length and punches it through to third-man for a single
fuller from round the stumps, slower too, flicked away to the leg side for a single
gone, caught at deep long-on! he pitches it fuller and he was looking to hit it straight this time, gets it high on the bat and he's been caught at long-on
short in length and Sammy, playing only his second ball, has pulled it in front of square-leg for a six! stylish shot too, lot of flair there!
shorter in length and cuts it through to deep poing for a single

gone, caught at long-on! it was wider and he goes down the track to hit it over the straight fielder, does not quite get to the pitch of the ball and hits it to Vijay at long-on who first takes a good-looking catch and then shows bit of a jig
shorter in length and he pulls it well in the gap but not with too much power and they get only a single
and now he hits it over that same in-fielder on the leg side, straight to the fielder outside the circle for a single
very short from the bowler and he wants to pull it, gets it straight to the in-fielder
on his pads from round the stumps, pats it down to long-on for a single
short of length and he wants to pull it away, no timing or power in the shot, goes straight to square-leg
slower one from the bowler from over the stumps, he checks his shot and flicks it to the leg side for a single
on a good length and outside the off, he wants to cut it away, can get it through to the deep point region for a single
shorter in length again and he wants to tap it back, there are fielders converging on that one from everywhere, almost as if the target was 123 and not a 100 more
shortish in length and tucked away to the leg side, to the fielder at square-leg
shortish in length from round the stumps and he continues to cut it, straight to the third-man fielder for a single
shorter in length and it's turned too, he was looking to sweep it but had to adjust his stroke and tap it away for a single
shorter in length and flicked away to the leg side for a single
fuller and driven down the ground, hard, to the wide mid-off region for a single
gone, caught! this has been top-edged to short fine-leg, gone for nothing! it was from round the stumps, wanted to sweep it away but does get it away off the middle, gives Morris an easy catch there
shorter in length, punched back to the bowler
shorter in length and looks to cut it, goes straight to the fielder

and chipped over the leg side, and if I were to be a really harsh man, I would say that Bravo's dropped him! but it's more of an excellent effort to run from fine-leg, towards deep square-leg and then dive forward to even attempt it, hits his hands and falls away
on a length and slower, he was looking to play it through the line, can only mis-time it back to the bowler, goes to mid-on
and wow! Parthiv's now socked it over the leg side for a four, he goes outside the leg stump, the bowler follows him but the batsman is able to time it over the leg side for a six!
short, wide and given a wide this time, he was trying to angle it away this time instead of pitching them within the stumps
and that's fuller now, Parthiv's waiting for it and he flicks it over the leg side for a four now, again that's timed beautifully here
makes room by going down the leg side, he sends it short and it seems to have bounced and gone over his head but not given a wide
very short and on his pads, he's flicked it away, in fact he's timed that away and it's almost gone away for a six, good shot that
shorter and swivelled and pulled away for a single
goes down the track, the bowler shortens his length and he taps it away to the leg side for a single
down the leg side and fuller, he was looking to sweep at it, misses and they are off for a bye
ooh, some turn now, beats the outside edge of the bat
down the leg side from over the wicket and it's not turned, given a wide
on his pads, full enough to tuck it away for a single
slower, fuller and driven back to the bowler
and that's through the line, it was fuller outside the off stump and Parthiv has hit it through the line and over the mid-off to the fence!
up and over but it takes a lot more height than it goes the distance, he was looking to flick it over the leg side by going across to the off side, Bravo gives chase and pulls it back
on a good length and that's tapped to mid-on for a single, it was a risky one too, Raina was quickly on to it and had he hit the non-striker's end, he would have been out
bouncer from Mohit which the batsman ducks under, this is a tad high though and it's given a wide
fuller on the middle from round the stumps, wants to drive it down the ground but not off the middle, straight to the fielder
and now he walks away to the off stump and pulls it towards the fine-leg region, the fielder's there and they get a single
and again, up and over, this is not quite Raina-like, not that tap over the in-field, but more of a cut, that's gone high and over the in-field to the fence
no change in the length, he's making them go back and defend, was on his body with that shorter length to, tapped to short fine-leg

gone, run-out! was looking to flick it over the leg side, misses the bat, hits the pads and they are off for a quick leg-bye, the ball's rolled over to the keeper who has a shy at the striker's end, tell you what, this is quite out!
up and over, he's been watching Raina, short of length and he plays it through the line, goes over the in-field for a four
continues that same length, shorter and on the middle stump, he was looking to tap it to the off side, is hurried in his stroke, they run for a quick one
